Package backend.classes

Class Orders

java.lang.Object
backend.classes.Orders
public class Orders extends Object
Represents an individual order item within a receipt.

Each Orders instance links a specific drink to a transaction and includes details such as quantity, total price, and all applied customizations (ice level, sweetness, and toppings). This class is primarily used for database operations when inserting, retrieving, or processing order data.
